prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Assign Your Pet's First Desktop Task", "Try giving your companion a quick task to see how it moves around your workspace.", "Send Pet on Task"]
1: ["Verifying desktop overlay compatibility and display rendering layer..."]
2: ["Master Desktop Pet Tray Controls", "Practice calling and minimizing your pet using your taskbar or menu tray.", "Practice Tray Toggle"]
3: ["Secure cloud save verified. Your pet selection will be permanently attached to this account.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled"]
4: ["Render check active: Clear single-subject photos ensure optimal 3D desktop companion rendering."]
5: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion Path", "Select how your pet will inhabit and interact with your workspace."]
6: ["Save Your Companion To Your Account", "Sign in now to lock in your companion certificate and enable cloud sync."]
7: ["Quick Reference Guide", "Keep these key commands handy to summon, feed, or pause your companion anytime.", "Click pet to interact | Right-click for menu | Drag to move", "Got It, Launch Pet!"]
8: ["Configuring desktop overlay window and display priority for smooth rendering...", "Desktop Window Layer: Active"]
9: ["Starter Trait Unlocked: Loyal Companion"]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency by telling the user to sign in now to lock in their certificate.
